title: Workflow use cases
description: How a change to a game gets from a branch to main, and from main to icelander.net when it is deployed by hand.

entities.name: Ship a change to a game
entities.description: A change made on a branch is checked on a pull request and merged to main. Merging deploys nothing: the game goes live only when it is deployed by hand (Deploy a game by hand).
entities.goal: Get a change to a game onto main, checked and ready to deploy.
preconditions: The change is on a branch, not on main: main takes only pull requests.
The game's own tests pass in its folder (npm test).
postconditions: Nothing was deployed: icelander.net runs each game's previous version until someone deploys it by hand.

flow.action: Pushes the branch and opens a pull request.
Validates every .dev file, lists the changed games, and tests and builds each one.
Passes when the pull request changes no database file, or acknowledges the migration.
Merges the pull request. Nothing is deployed.

alternatives.condition: The pull request changes only .dev files, outside .github/ or not.
alternatives.outcome: No game is tested; the validators still run.

alternatives.condition: A validator, a game's tests or its build fail, or the build holds a .dev folder.
alternatives.outcome: That job fails on the pull request.

alternatives.condition: A database file changed and the description has no acknowledgement.
alternatives.outcome: The check fails and main refuses the merge until the migration is applied and acknowledged (Migrate a game's database).

entities.name: Deploy a game by hand
entities.description: The owner, or an agent the owner asks, deploys one game from main with npm run deploy in its folder. Nothing else deploys a game since the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23.
entities.goal: See a change to a game live on icelander.net.
preconditions: The change is merged to main (Ship a change to a game).
The machine deploying has a Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account, and Godot 4.7.2 for the Godot games.
postconditions: The game runs the deployed commit on icelander.net.

flow.action: Checks, as docs/database-migrations.md says, that every migration the code needs has been applied to production; no gate checks this before a hand deploy.
Runs npm run deploy in the game's folder, on an up-to-date main.
Runs the game's tests and build, then wrangler deploy uploads its Worker and assets to Cloudflare.

alternatives.condition: A migration the code needs has not been applied.
alternatives.outcome: Apply it first (Migrate a game's database), then deploy.

alternatives.condition: The game's tests or build fail.
alternatives.outcome: Nothing is uploaded; the game stays as it was.

relatedViews.relationship: What to do when the migration check fails.
The workflows that carry it out.
